name: The Shadow Of Ayutthaya
description:
About This Game

The Shadow of Ayutthaya – Beta Test

This is a beta version that allows players to experience the game before its full release. The game is not yet complete, and some features may be disabled or unavailable at this stage. The purpose of this beta test is to gather feedback from players to improve gameplay, fix bugs, and refine the overall experience. The full version of the game is planned to be developed continuously and is expected to be completed within the next 3 years. Thank you for being a part of building The Shadow of Ayutthaya with us.

ABOUT THIS GAME

Step into the shadows of Thailand's most legendary kingdom.

The Shadow Of Ayutthaya is an immersive action-adventure game that plunges you into the heart of ancient Siam during its most tumultuous era. Experience the rise and fall of the magnificent Ayutthaya Kingdom through the eyes of a lone warrior caught between duty, honor, and survival.

Story

Kabin, a man who has been deceived all along, until later he meets Kaew Sai and discovers the truth of the whole story. With gameplay in the form of Action-Rpg and Souls-like games, it gives off the feel of Ayutthaya and is developed by only two Thai people! And with weapons and an environment that is Thai, along with Thai voice acting...

A Kingdom Under Siege

Set in the 16th century, witness the golden age of the Ayutthaya Kingdom as it faces its greatest threats. Navigate through a world where political intrigue, ancient traditions, and foreign invasions collide. As the shadow of war looms over the land, you must forge your own path through a narrative rich with historical authenticity and cultural depth.

Master the Art of Ancient Combat

Engage in visceral, skill-based combat that blends traditional Thai martial arts with medieval weaponry. Wield ancient Siamese weapons, master the deadly art of Krabi-Krabong, and face enemies ranging from rival warriors to legendary creatures of Thai folklore. Every encounter tests your reflexes, strategy, and mastery of combat techniques passed down through generations.

Explore a Living, Breathing Ancient World

Journey through meticulously recreated historical locations:

  • Royal Palaces - Navigate the opulent halls of power where kings and nobles plot

  • Sacred Temples - Discover ancient Buddhist sanctuaries hiding secrets and treasures

  • Bustling Markets - Experience the vibrant trade routes that made Ayutthaya prosper

  • War-torn Battlefields - Survive massive siege warfare and epic battles

  • Mysterious Ruins - Uncover lost knowledge in forgotten corners of the kingdom

Shape Your Destiny

Your choices matter. Navigate complex moral decisions that will determine not only your fate, but the destiny of the kingdom itself. Form alliances with historical figures, uncover conspiracies that threaten the throne, and decide whether to preserve tradition or embrace change in a world on the brink of transformation.

From Thailand, For the World

The Shadow Of Ayutthaya is built with passion by Thai developers who understand the importance of cultural heritage. It's not just a game, it's a bridge between past and present, East and West. Whether you're a history buff, an action game enthusiast, or a fan of Thai culture, this epic adventure offers a rich experience for everyone. And with just two developers,

Use! Shadows! as! Weapons!!
short_desc: Betrayed all his life, Gabin seeks truth alongside Kaewsai in this brutal Souls-like Action-RPG. Wield shadows as weapons, master ancient Thai combat, and survive the fall of Ayutthaya. An authentic Thai experience by two passionate developers.
